qualification.details: Junior Research Fellow (JRF): M.Sc. in Entomology/Agricultural Entomology/ Zoology/ any relevant discipline of life sciences from a recognized university. Experience: Experience in insect collection, preservation and taxonomic identification. Hands-on experience in insect dissection microscopy, scientific imaging and molecular techniques (DNA extraction, PCR, DNA barcoding, and sequence analysis). Knowledge of phylogenetic analysis, biodiversity surveys, museum curation, and scientific writing with research publications will be preferred.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for ICAR IARI Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 31-08-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Junior Research Fellow position at ICAR IARI?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Junior Research Fellow position at ICAR IARI is 31st August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold an M.Sc. degree in Entomology, Agricultural Entomology, Zoology, or any relevant discipline of life sciences from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to this post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 35 years for men and 40 years for women. Age relaxation is provided for SC/ST, OBC, and PwBD candidates.

faq.question: Q4. How will the candidates be selected for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position will be based on a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 37,000/-.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email to the designated email address.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the Walk-in Interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview will be conducted at the Indian Agricultural Research Institute (ICAR IARI) in New Delhi.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required to be sent along with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates need to send their duly filled application format, CV, and scanned copies of all relevant documents as a single merged PDF file.

faq.question: Q10. Does ICAR IARI offer any relaxation in the age limit?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided for SC/ST (5 years), OBC (3 years), and PwBD (10 years) candidates.
